tournament.stations.title: Stations
tournament.streams.handle.label: Channel handle
tournament.streams.intro: Attach your channel handle to this event, then paste its overlay URLs into OBS browser sources. Put a set on stream from its own dialog (open any set on the bracket or grid and use the stream row), and the queue below orders what you've put there; the overlay follows it and advances itself as sets finish.
tournament.streams.none: No streams are attached to this event.
tournament.streams.overlays.help: Paste each into an OBS browser source. Set once, never edited.
tournament.streams.overlays.title: OBS overlay URLs
tournament.streams.producerOnly: This stream's queue is run by its producer: the event host or its appointed Streamer.
tournament.streams.remove.label: Remove {handle} from this event
tournament.streams.route.label: Push this tournament's sets to {handle}
tournament.streams.several: Several streams are attached, so the camera button on a set asks which to add it to.
tournament.swiss.nextRound.note: Pairs the next Swiss round from the standings so far (round {next} of {total}). Players are matched on equal records, avoiding rematches.
tournament.swiss.round1Note: Round 1 is set by seed. Later rounds are paired on results once this round is played.
tournament.tiebreak.fifthSeventh.note: Play off 5th and 7th place between the players tied there. Each match joins the queue once its pair is out.
tournament.tiebreak.label: Tiebreaks
tournament.tiebreak.remove.confirm: Remove this tiebreak{reported, select, yes { and its result} other {}}?
tournament.tiebreak.third.note: Play a 3rd place match between the semi-final losers. It joins the queue once both are out.
tournament.top8.notEnough: Not enough results to generate a Top 8 Graphic.

tournament.vod.label: Label
tournament.walkUp.description: For an attendee with no account. They join the signup list, seed like any other entry, and resolve to a player later.
tournament.walkUp.handleNote: The name they play under. Never their real name.
